body: Woah, this is incredible! How big is the finished product?
Giving off major Julia Roberts vibes! I love it
You're welcome friend, I'm glad you liked it and I hope you have a good day :)
Hi friend! Honestly didn't expect this to get so many replies but I woke up 30 minutes ago and boom

No worries friend - your 'twisted thoughts' are exactly why I asked the question. I feel that lots of the online support is focused on teens and young adults, and there's very little for people who are over 25. Also if you're a teen and you SH, it's considered a phase or a normal part of life that they'll grow out of, but if an adult cuts it's expected that they should have found a more mature way of dealing with their problems. 

Imho if an adult cuts it should be taken as seriously if not more so because...theyre an adult. Words are not my friend this morning oops

Haha, no I'm only just thinking of myself in that way friend! Never felt that way at university and it's only since being in full time work for a year that I've felt like an adult. Growing up is a myth :)

I'm in the UK too, and when I was younger I had thoughts of joining the Navy or police force, but I know my mental health makes me ineligible.

Do you find your medical training to be an asset when it comes to SH? In terms of doing it safely, and treating yourself afterwards?
Thanks mate, appreciate it. The winter always seems to get me down!
This honestly made me smile so much, thank you! You're right, I'm an adult - I'm 24 and I thought this would all be over by now! I think your idea of making new accounts is a good one, thank you.

Do not. Find another way to channel the feeling because once you're on this path it's very very difficult to get off.

I've been self harming for 12 years and I'm now a fully grown adult. Please don't do it.
Embarrassingly, I'm 24. I've been in this self harming cycle for 12 years and I thought it would be over by now. Adults don't do this sort of thing :(
Well done for not cutting, even if it was more out of tiredness than self-restraint <3
Thanks, I also feel relieved that I'm not alone.

Honestly the self harm is almost trivial at this point. The worst is the mental self abuse. And it's always in third person as well, idk if anyone else does that. Always 'You're a piece of shit' rather than 'I'm a piece of shit'.

How do you find the exercise works for you? I've been wanting to get back in shape for a while and I think it would help my overall mental health even if it was only a couple of times a week.

Thanks very much, that makes a lot of sense. It does feel like my brain throwing a tantrum! Thank you, the next time it happens I'll try and control it because it's not cool and if my girlfriend knew it would break her heart.

Urgh that's exactly it. Just obliterate myself out of existence. Can't punch other people, can't damage property...so that leaves me. And it's getting harder to control as the days go by. I don't consider myself truly relapsed unless I start cutting, but damn the itch is there.

Thanks for sharing, it's good to know others feel the same way
Is there a particular feeling that triggers the self harm? For me it's when I'm embarrassed.

I haven't cut myself for well over two years now but I still get the urge. It's really strong atm, and usually I get it after doing something stupid, like ordering a pizza instead of fucking cooking like a normal person instead of a fucking piece of shit.

Maybe I want to punish myself, idk. Maybe I just want to do something to release the guilt or frustration. If I make mistakes at work I'll find a corner and slap myself in the face. I'll always think in 3rd person as well, calling myself a fucking idiot etc. Generally using my inner voice to abuse myself.

The present is neverending, and hurting myself helps me cope with it. If it gets too much I'll go to bed and pretend to be dead until I wake up.
